title: Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz zur Versammlungslage am 1. Mai 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin's May Day demonstrations on 1 May 2026 were largely peaceful, with over 90 assemblies and more than 70,000 participants. Police reported 87 custodial measures, 121 criminal investigations, and 15 officers injured, including during a clash along the Oranienplatz to Südstern march.
